intro:
Dispatch the Right Hero Now!
Choose the best hero from four unique powers and defeat the villain!
description:
A hero-selection puzzle game where you must choose the perfect hero to stop villains threatening the city.

Should you send the hero who controls fire, the one who commands lightning, or the one who can turn invisible?

Each hero has unique strengths—and unexpected weaknesses.
Study the villain carefully and choose the one hero best suited for the mission!

“Wait… this hero looked stronger. Why did I fail?!”
“Ah, so that ability is actually a weakness here!”

Enjoy solving each challenge on your own, or team up with friends and discuss the best strategy together. It’s also perfect as a casual party game.

Clear every mission and become the greatest commander at the Hero Dispatch Center!
